title: Opening and introductions, Tulane Seminar Room
summary: Allen identifies himself, the date and the location, and sets up to play a record.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Yeah, I think it's close enough. Why don't you give your name so we'll know that?
And my name's Dick Allen, and let's see, what's the day? Today's the 28th?

28th of March, 1963. That's right. And we're in the Seminar Room 2 at the Howard Tilton Library at Tulane University. And, uh, since you haven't heard this in a while, I want to play something for you. Recognize it? I want to see if we got the Ann Cook record.
